orders.invalidSalesPerson: The salesperson ID must be a positive integer
orders.invalidItems: The order requires items with a valid product, quantity, and price

users.invalidId: The ID must be a valid positive integer
users.invalidPassword: The password must be a non-empty string

roles.invalidId: The ID must be a valid positive integer
roles.invalidName: The role name is required and must be at most 50 characters
roles.invalidPermissions: permission_ids must be an array of existing permission IDs, without duplicates
roles.nameTaken: A role with that name already exists
roles.inUse: A role with assigned users cannot be deleted

inventory.invalidId: ID must be a valid positive integer
inventory.invalidQuantity: stock and reserved are required and must be integers between 0 and 2147483647

permissions.invalidId: The ID must be a valid positive integer
permissions.invalidKey: The key must follow the resource:action:possession format, for example orders:read:own
permissions.keyTaken: A permission with that key already exists
permissions.inUse: A permission assigned to roles cannot be deleted; remove it from those roles first

products.invalidId: The ID must be a valid positive integer
products.invalidBody: Invalid product data: name, description and brand are required
products.invalidPrice: The price must be a number greater than or equal to zero
products.inUse: A product with associated variants cannot be deleted; remove its variants first

customers.invalidId: The ID must be a valid ObjectId
customers.invalidUserId: userId is required and must be a positive integer
customers.invalidAddressType: The address type must be SHIPPING or BILLING
customers.duplicate: A customer with that data already exists
customers.userNotFound: The specified user does not exist
customers.hasOrders: A customer with registered orders cannot be deleted

variants.invalidId: The ID must be a valid positive integer
variants.invalidProductId: product_id must be a valid positive integer
variants.invalidBody: sku, size and color are required and allow up to 100, 30 and 50 characters, respectively
variants.productNotFound: The specified product does not exist
variants.inUse: A variant with stock or reserved units cannot be deleted
